heading_path: Division 4—Removal from Register of Trade Marks Attorneys
20A.8  Failure to maintain professional indemnity insurance
text: (1) If an incorporated trade marks attorney does not maintain adequate and appropriate professional indemnity insurance, the Designated Manager may remove the name of the attorney from the Register of Trade Marks Attorneys. (2) If the Designated Manager removes the name of the incorporated trade marks attorney from the Register of Trade Marks Attorneys, the Designated Manager must notify, in writing, the attorney of the removal.
